title: The Fat You Burn and the Fat You Lose — NIH Isocaloric Carbohydrate vs. Fat Restriction, 24-Hour Respiratory Quotient & Cumulative Fat Balance

teenKit.tldr: The Fat You Burn and the Fat You Lose (NIH Isocaloric Carbohydrate vs. Fat Restriction, 24-Hour Respiratory Quotient & Cumulative Fat Balance): Metabolic chamber and stoichiometric dissection of Hall et al. (2015) NIH inpatient crossover: why reduced carbohydrate lowered 24-hour RQ and increased fat oxidation (+403 kcal/day) while reduced fat.
teenKit.whyItMatters: Tracing the primary evidence behind The Fat You Burn and the Fat You Lose connects nutrition metabolism breakthroughs directly to how we diagnose, test, and understand the real world.
keyTakeaways: Metabolic chamber and stoichiometric dissection of Hall et al.
microscopic nuances of human fat loss.
